title: SupplierProfile
description: Curated enrichment for selected suppliers (P3-002/P3-003); not populated from organizer CSVs. market_role is separate from Supplier.entity_type (HD-09). Every role other than 'unknown' needs a basis and >= 1 SupplierEvidence (BR-47). Manufacturer VERIFIED only from an official registry or explicit first-party production evidence; OKVED alone -> INFERRED (displayed as INFERRED_MANUFACTURER_CANDIDATE) (ADR-H1 A2). Individuals/IEs: registry-public fields only, no contacts (NFR-PRIV-01).

display_name.description: Legal name from a registry or the company's own site (evidence-backed).

region.description: Registered/production region as stated by the source (evidence-backed).

role_basis.description: official_registry = e.g. ГИСП / реестр российской промышленной продукции; first_party_production = the company's own site/catalog explicitly stating own production (plant, address); okved = legal-registry activity code only; procurement_history = observed supplying in organizer data; procurement_pattern = inferred from breadth of won categories; declared = unverified self-description; manual_review = team review of cited evidence.

observed_at.description: When the profile facts were observed/verified.
